list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Potassium salt of a hexacerium(IV) cluster-containing Keggin polyoxometalate trimer

source_locations.location: Supporting information, Experimental Section, “Synthesis of K18Ce6-POM”

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A central Ce6 oxo/hydroxide cluster cation, [Ce6(μ3-O)4(μ3-OH)4(OAc)2]10+, connects two trilacunary A-α-SiW9O34 Keggin units and one monolacunary α-SiW11O39 Keggin unit, forming a trimeric Keggin polyanion. Two acetate ligands bridge cerium atoms in the cluster.

synthesis.procedure: The potassium salt of open-Dawson polyoxometalate (K-open POM) was reacted with ammonium cerium(IV) nitrate in 0.5 M KOAc/HOAc buffer at 80 °C. The preparation account gives no numerical reagent amount or reaction duration for this product.

reagents.name: potassium salt of open-Dawson polyoxometalate (K-open POM)

synthesis.time: 30 min heating; 5 min additional stirring; 20 days crystallization; 2 h drying
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Collect the pale yellow precipitate on a JG 0.2 μm membrane filter. Dissolve the crude product in minimal water and evaporate slowly. After 20 days, collect the pale yellow plate crystals on a JG 0.2 μm membrane filter, wash with cold water, and dry in vacuo for 2 h.

title: Synthesis and crystal structure of hexacerium(IV) cluster-containing Keggin polyoxometalate trimer
